newsitem.title: USA: Above-normal temps expected in western US - NWS.
newsitem.headline: Above-normal temps expected in western US - NWS.

text.p: National Weather Service said Thursday it expected above-normal temperatures in a large portion of the western United States in May.

Above-normal temperatures are expected in Washington State, the western half of Oregon, California and the southern half of the Great Basin. It said most of New Mexico, southwestern Texas, the southern portion of the Florida peninsula and the southern coast of Alaska will also experience above-normal temperatures.
Below-normal temperatures, however, will be felt in the northern parts of Minnesota, Wisconsin and Michigan, the NWS said in its monthly report.

The weather agency said it expected above-median precipitation in New Mexico and below-median precipitation in the interior southeast. The Pacific Northwest and Alaska should also experience a wet May, NWS reported.
The next 30-day outlook will be issued on Thursday, May 15.
